name: ptee-contain-infra-blast-radius
title: Contain the blast radius: keep pods away from the control plane
summary: The worst blast radius isn't another app pod - it's the cluster's own control plane. Use a GlobalNetworkPolicy to lock the etcd datastore down to the kube-apiserver, so no application pod can ever reach the cluster's crown jewels, and learn where HostEndpoints take this further.
